profile.name: Huber Petite Fleur循环冷却器
profile.description: 这是一台台式循环冷却与恒温控制设备，通过循环传热液体为浴槽或外部实验装置提供稳定的温度控制。实验中常用于维持设定温度、监测浴液温度，并按设定程序或斜坡方式改变温度。
profile.description_en: A benchtop recirculating chiller and temperature-control unit that circulates heat-transfer fluid to provide stable temperature control for a bath or external laboratory equipment. It is commonly used in labs to maintain a set temperature, monitor bath temperature, and change temperature using ramps or control programs.
